How the money splits

When a move is done and you tap Done, the held cash splits right away. Say nothing and don't ask for a check, and they split when your 15 minutes run out:

95% to the Sim · 5% to the house. A $150 move pays her $142 and the house keeps $8. If she skips a move, or the rules block it, nobody gets paid — you get all of it back.

The Rules

Short and clear. The game checks every request against these rules.

!Never allowed

  • ✕No request may pay anyone to hurt a person — no hits, no dares that injure, no "pranks" on strangers.
  • ✕Nothing illegal. If it's a crime off camera, it's banned on camera.
  • ✕No minors — not as Sims, not as players, not in the room.
  • ✕No meeting up. Cash buys camera time and camera moves only — never a person, never a place.
  • ✕No personal info: no real names, addresses, phone numbers, or schools in a request.
  • ✕No weapons, no drugs, no threats, no blackmail.

Every request you write gets checked against this list before any cash moves. A blocked request costs nothing.

✓Always allowed

  • ✓Anything on the Sim's own menu — she wrote it, she priced it.
  • ✓Your own requests, if they fit her will-do list: dances, songs, study sessions, cooking, shoutouts, games, dares that stay safe and legal.
  • ✓Adult moves between checked 18+ adults, on camera, only if her list allows them.
  • ✓Her will-NOT list outranks your cash. A skip is instant, final, and fully refunded.

Every Sim's card carries her own limits in writing. The menu is the contract.

≡A move, step by step

  1. You pick or write a move and set the cash.
  2. The rules check it. Not allowed = blocked, and it costs nothing.
  3. Your cash is held safe — not spent yet.
  4. She has 3 minutes to say yes or skip it.
  5. Skip = all your cash back, right away.
  6. Yes = she has 20 minutes to do it, live on camera.
  7. When she is done, you tap Done within 15 minutes.
  8. No tap and no complaint in 15 minutes = she still gets paid.
  9. The held cash splits: 95% to her, 5% to the house.
  10. Every dollar is written down in your Cash Bank list.

§Problems & your account

If something goes wrong. Ask for a check within your 15 minutes and the cash stays held — nobody gets paid while the house watches the room recording. If the tape shows she didn't do it, you get all your cash back. Fake complaints lower your level.

Getting paid. Sims keep the cash they earn. No extra fees — the house already took its 5% at the split. First payout waits for the ID check.
